evidence_items.explanation: For 2024-12-01 to 2025-02-20, within 200 km of Billings at M2 or above, USGS lists only eight events. All are classified as mining explosions near Ranchester WY, Colstrip and Muddy MT, and none is an earthquake. This supports Marcus's finding that no recent Billings earthquake occurred.
